lines: Jo kabhi bin bole sab samajh jaate the,
Aaj unhe apni baat samjhana bhi ek bojh lagta hai.
Log badalte hain toh dard utna nahi hota,
Jitna unke badalne ka tareeka tod deta hai.
Pehle roz ki aadat the hum unki,
Aaj ek mulaqaat ke liye bhi waqt nahi hai unke paas.
Kisi ko toot kar chahne se behtar tha,
Khud se thoda sa selfish ho jaate toh bach jaate.
Jinhe apna maana tha wahi gair nikle,
Ab kisi aur se wafa ki ummeed kya hi karein.
Narazgi toh apno se hoti hai,
Par jab apne hi strangers ban jaayein toh khamoshi hi sahi.
Rishte badal jaate hain bina kisi aahat ke,
Aur hum wahin khade purani yaadein count karte reh jaate hain.
Sabse bada dhokha tab milta hai,
Jab fark padna band ho jaaye usko jiske bina tumhara guzara nahi tha.
Loyalty ki baatein sab karte hain,
Par nibhane ki baari aaye toh pehle wahi peeche hat-te hain.
Kal tak jo har baat share karte the,
Aaj unke baare mein dusron se pata chalta hai.
Kuch log paas hokar bhi itne door ho jaate hain,
Ki unki awaaz bhi ab parayi lagti hai.
Badal gaye hain wo jinke badalne ka kabhi khayal bhi nahi tha,
Zindagi ne har ek misunderstanding clear kar di.
Ab toh unka badla hua roop dekh kar darr lagta hai,
Kya yeh wahi hain jin par blindly trust kiya tha?
Apno se mile zakhm bohot gehre hote hain,
Heal toh ho jaate hain par scars kabhi nahi jaate.
Rishta tootne par itna dard nahi hota,
Jitna rishte mein reh kar akelepan ka feel hota hai.
Humne toh sirf loyalty di thi unse,
Par unhone humari simplicity ko bewakoofi samajh liya.
Pehle wo hume khone se darte the,
Ab humare hone na hone se koi fark nahi padta unhe.
Zaroorat thi jab sabse zyada unki,
Tab hi unhone apna real face dikhaya.
Baatein wahi hain par wo feeling nahi rahi,
Apne toh hain par wo purani vibe nahi rahi.
Wajah toh bohot thi unke paas rukh badalne ki,
Par hum toh bas unke ek ishare par tike rehte the.
Mohabbat thi isliye jaane diya,
Agar ego hoti toh baahon mein hoti.
Dil bhi tumhara tha, mohabbat bhi tumhari thi,
Bas akelapan mera ho gaya permanently.
Hume kahan maloom tha ki ishq hota kya hai,
Bas tum mile aur zindagi pehle love ban gayi... phir dard.
Tumne toh sirf timepass ke liye naam liya tha,
Hum khaamkhaah khud ko tumhari poori duniya samajh baithe.
Badi ajeeb si love story thi tumhari,
Pehle apna banaya, phir paraya, phir stranger.
Hum bhi muskuraate the kabhi bina reason,
Ab toh reason dhundhni padti hai smile karne ke liye.
Koi mila hi nahi jis par dil lagaate,
Har ek ne dhokha diya, kis kis ko yaad rakhein.
Kaash tum samajh paate mere dil ka dard,
Toh yun bewajah hume tanha na chodte.
Tum muskuraate hue ache lagte the,
Isliye humne rote hue bhi tumhe alvida keh diya.
Tere bina ye dil ab dhadakta toh hai,
Par sirf survive karne ke liye, khushi ke liye nahi.
Kitna bhi care karo kisi ko, kam lagta hai,
Jab apna hi koi change ho jaaye, toh sab toot jaata hai.
One-sided love bhi kitna ajeeb hota hai na,
Takleef apni hoti hai aur galti bhi kisi ki nahi.
Naam tera hi rahega meri har saans mein,
Chahe tu mujhe yaad rakhe ya forget kar de.
Tumhari khushi ke liye door hue the tumse,
Warna humari love mein koi kami nahi thi.
Chaha tha tumhe jaan se bhi zyada,
Par tum toh sirf ek dream bankar reh gaye.
Kabhi free ho toh sochna zaroor,
Ek so-called beparwah tumhari itni parwah kyun karta tha.
Love mein haarna bura nahi lagta,
Bura tab lagta hai jab apna hi koi defeat kar de.
Hum toh unke liye ek normal insaan the,
Aur wo humare liye poori duniya.
Wo chale gaye hume akela choddkar,
Par unki yaadein aaj bhi yahin rehti hain.
Kitni ajeeb baat hai na, tum ab mere nahi ho,
Phir bhi ye dil tumhe hi miss karta hai.
Bohot chhupaya maine is duniya se,
Par meri aankhon ne sab reveal kar diya.
Ab koi hope nahi bachi tere aane ki,
Phir bhi ye nazrein door pe hi tik jaati hain.
Faasle aise bhi honge kabhi socha na tha,
Saamne baitha tha wo aur wo mera nahi tha.
Chupchap guzar jaate hain wo raaston se,
Jo kabhi meri aahat par bhi ruk jaaya karte the.
Dooriyon se hi pata chalta hai,
Kaun kitna close hai actually.
Jab apna hi koi chhod jaata hai,
Toh poori duniya par se trust uth jaata hai.
Bichhad kar tumse bas itna hi seekha hai,
Ki mohabbat jitni deep hogi, wound utna hi bada hoga.
Ab koi complaint nahi hai tumse,
Kyunki galti tumhari nahi, meri expectations ki thi.
Tumse door jaana meri marzi nahi thi,
Bas tumhare liye hi tumhe chhodna pada.
Na jaane kaisi dushmani thi kismat ki humse,
Jisse bhi dil lagaya, wahi door ho gaya.
Raaste alag ho gaye toh kya hua,
Destination toh meri aaj bhi tum hi ho.
Silence bohot kuch kehti hai,
Kaan lagakar nahi, dil lagakar suno.
Ab toh har khushi mein bhi ek sadness chhupa hota hai,
Jab se tum door gaye ho, ye dil rota hai.
Alvida kehte waqt wo smile kar diye,
Aur hum unki khushi ke liye ro bhi na sake.
Tum chale gaye par tumhari khushboo aaj bhi baaki hai,
Is veeraan dil mein teri yaad hi kaafi hai.
Faasle toh sirf physical hain,
Warna ye dil toh aaj bhi tumhare paas hi hai.
Bohot dard hota hai jab koi apna,
Suddenly stranger ban jaata hai.
Ab toh raaton ki neend bhi chheen li tumhari yaadon ne,
Aur tum kehte ho ki hum tumhe yaad nahi karte.
Kaash wo time wahin ruk jaata,
Jab tum mere paas the aur sab kuch perfect tha.
Tere jaane ke baad ye city bhi veeraan lagti hai,
Har koi stranger, har chehra unknown lagta hai.
Zakhm itne diye tumne ki ab dard feel nahi hota,
Dil aisa toota ki ab koi apna nahi lagta.
Jhoothe promises aur kasme di thi tumne,
Aur hum bewakoof sab blindly believe kar baithe.
Jis par sabse zyada bharosa tha,
Usi ne sabse bada dhokha diya.
Love mein bewafai ka zehar ghol diya tumne,
Ek hasta hua dil tadapkar tod diya tumne.
Kabhi socha na tha ki ek din tum bhi change ho jaoge,
Duniya ki tarah tum bhi mujhse muh mod loge.
Game acha khela tumne mere dil ke saath,
Jeet tumhari hui aur haar meri mohabbat ki.
Faces badal gaye, insaan badal gaye,
Time ke saath unke intentions badal gaye.
Kitna easy tha tumhare liye bye bolna,
Aur kitna mushkil hai mere liye akele rehna.
Ab kisi par trust nahi hota,
Kyunki sachcha pyaar ab baar baar nahi milta.
Glass ka dil tha mera, tumne patthar maarkar tod diya,
Beech raah mein laakar akele hi chhod diya.
Tumhari baaton mein jo sweetness thi,
Wo actually ek meetha poison tha.
Change ho jaate hain wo log time ki tarah,
Jinhe had se zyada pyaar diya jaata hai.
Dil todne ke liye thanks tumhe,
Kam se kam ab hum kisi par depend toh nahi karenge.
Bewafai ki bhi limit hoti hai,
Tumne toh meri loyalty ka mazaak bana diya.
Trust ek baar toot jaaye toh phir kabhi jud nahi paata,
Chahe insaan kitna bhi sorry bole.
Tum toh badal gaye apni convenience ke hisaab se,
Par hum aaj bhi wahin khade hain tumhari yaad mein.
Dard is baat ka nahi ki tum kisi aur ke ho gaye,
Dard is baat ka hai ki tumne mujhe false hopes diye.
Sach hi kaha hai kisine,
Need khatam toh rishte bhi khatam.
Ab tumhe fark nahi padta mere rone ya hasne se,
Kyunki tum toh move on kar chuke ho naye logon ke saath.
Humari loyalty ko tumne meri majboori samjha,
Aur khud ko innocent prove kar diya.
Ye raatein bohot lambi lagti hain,
Jab teri yaadein dil par dastak deti hain.
Sab so jaate hain apni apni khushiyon ke saath,
Aur hum apni purani memories ko seene se lagakar rote hain.
Aaj phir teri yaad ne rula diya,
Sote hue dil ko phir se jaga diya.
Raaton ka silence bohot kuch keh jaata hai,
Jab koi apna bas yaadon mein reh jaata hai.
Tumhari purani chats padh kar smile aa jaata hai,
Aur phir apni helplessness par aansu baha leta hoon.
Andhera hi acha hai is ujaale se,
Kam se kam mere tears kisi ko dikhte toh nahi.
Kitni raatein guzaari hain jaag jaag kar,
Sirf ek tumhare message ke wait mein.
Tumhari yaadein bhi bilkul tumhari tarah hain,
Bina bataaye aa jaati hain aur rulakar chali jaati hain.
Ye chand bhi aaj akela lagta hai,
Bilkul meri tarah is aasmaan mein.
Dreams mein hi sahi, tum aaj bhi mere paas aate ho,
Par subah aankh khulte hi phir se lonely chhod jaate ho.
Neend ab aankhon mein aati hi nahi,
Tumhari yaadein dil se jaati hi nahi.
Silent raat, sad dil aur teri yaad,
Bas yahi bacha hai ab meri life mein tumhare baad.
Pillow ko bhigokar sona ab habit ban gayi hai,
Tere bina ye zindagi ek punishment ban gayi hai.
Beeta hua time bohot yaad aata hai,
Jab tum mere close the aur sab kuch right tha.
Har raat ek hi sawaal aata hai mind mein,
Kya tumhe bhi kabhi meri yaad aati hai?
Wo photos aaj bhi saved hain mere phone mein,
Jinme tum mera haath thaam kar smile kar rahe the.
Yaadon ka ocean umad aata hai raat hote hi,
Aur hum doob jaate hain tere thoughts mein.
Kitna easy hota na agar yaadon ko bhi delete kiya ja sakta,
Toh kaash main is pain se aaj free hota.
Raaton ko uth uthkar rona koi humse pooche,
Mohabbat ka real pain koi humse pooche.
Silence bolta hai aur hum sunte hain,
Andhere mein baithkar teri hi yaadein chunte hain.
Bheed mein bhi akela feel karta hoon,
Jab se tumse baat hona band hui hai.
Hasna toh chhod diya hai humne logo ke liye,
Bas fake smile de dete hain dard chhupane ke liye.
Life toh chal rahi hai apni speed se,
Par dil wahin ruk gaya hai jahan tumne chhoda tha.
Ab kisi naye insaan se milne ka dil nahi karta,
Dar lagta hai ki wo bhi tumhari tarah leave na kar jaaye.
Tootkar bikhra hoon is qadar,
Ki ab khud ko fix karna impossible lagta hai.
Dard chhupana seekh liya hai maine,
Ab face par fake smile sajana seekh liya hai maine.
Log poochte hain itne quiet kyun rehte ho,
Ab unhe kya batayein ki andar kitna noise hai.
Zindagi mein kuch turns aise bhi aate hain,
Jahan chahkar bhi insaan smile nahi kar paata.
Akele chalna seekh liya hai maine,
Kyunki saath chalne waale aksar raah badal lete hain.
Ab kisi se koi expectations nahi rakhta,
Kyunki expectations hi dard ki reason banti hain.
Ye dil ab empty empty sa lagta hai,
Jaise ismein ab koi dream hi na bacha ho.
Rone se dard kam nahi hota,
Par dil ka weight thoda halka ho jaata hai.
Zindagi ne bohot kuch sikhaya,
Par tumhare bina jeena nahi sikhaya.
Ab toh dard bhi apna sa lagta hai,
Aur khushiyan stranger si lagti hain.
Kaash koi aisa hota jo dil ka haal samajh paata,
Bina kuch kahe meri aankhon ke tears padh paata.
Har roz khud se ek hi promise karta hoon,
Ki aaj tumhe miss nahi karunga... aur phir haar jaata hoon.
Dil ka tootna bhi bohot silent hota hai,
Na koi sound hota hai na koi blast... bas sab khatam ho jaata hai.
Ab toh khud se bhi nafrat hone lagi hai,
Kyunki ye dil aaj bhi sirf tumhe hi chahta hai.
Sab kehte hain time har wound heal kar deta hai,
Par kuch wounds itne deep hote hain ki time bhi haar jaata hai.
Ab bas sukoon ki talaash hai,
Chahe wo life mein mile ya uske baad.
